description: This file defines the 'dmUtility' class which provides various static utility functions for string manipulation, parsing, and handling query parameters, likely used within a larger data model or configuration context.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string processing, query parsing, and other helper functions related to data model management.

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Extracts the filename or last component from a query string based on last '.' or '\' characters.

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Determines if a character string ends with a '.' indicating a wildcard.

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes trailing '.' from a string if present.

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the property segment after the last '.' in a string.

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Extracts the property name after the last '.' in a string.

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the set indicator and braces if the string represents a multi-set property.

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a string representing multiple key-value pairs enclosed in braces into a vector of pairs.

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter character.
